description.en: The exam joins topics from different weeks. Link ideas across weeks, recognise which weeks a question joins, and write the joining sentence.
description.zh: 考试会把不同周的内容合在一起。把各周的概念连起来，认出一道题合并了哪几周，再写出那句“连接的话”。

name.en: Linking concepts across weeks in one answer
name.zh: 在一份答案里把不同周的概念连起来

description.en: each exam question is about one week of the course
description.zh: 每道考题只考一周的内容

description.en: listing two concepts side by side counts as linking them
description.zh: 把两个概念并排列出来就算连起来了

title.en: The question that does not fit in a week

text.en: The lecturer’s own sample question puts two sentences together: a pricing paper from week 10 (small price changes have a big effect on profit) and a theory from week 8 (transaction costs in running a business). The three parts then ask: explain transaction costs **and why they matter to pricing**; apply the three types to a company’s make-or-buy decisions; recommend two **pricing** moves that cut transaction costs.
text.zh: 讲师自己的样题把两句话放在一起：一篇第 10 周的定价论文（小幅价格变化对利润影响巨大）和一个第 8 周的理论（经营企业中的交易成本）。三个部分接着问：解释交易成本**以及它为什么对定价重要**；把三类交易成本应用到一家公司的自制或外购决策；给出两条能降低交易成本的**定价**建议。

text.en: A student who studied each week alone knows both halves and still cannot write the **joining sentence**. That is the skill of this lesson.
text.zh: 一周一周孤立学过的学生，两半内容都懂，却仍写不出那句**连接的话**。这就是这节课的技能。

prompt.en: Which sentence joins transaction costs (week 8) with pricing (week 10) rather than just listing both?
prompt.zh: 下面哪一句把交易成本（第 8 周）和定价（第 10 周）连起来了，而不只是并排列出？

label.en: “Because outsourcing adds safeguarding and measurement costs, the total cost of buying rises, so the cost floor under the price is higher than the supplier’s price suggests.”
label.zh: “因为外包增加了保障和计量成本，外购的总成本上升，所以价格之下的成本底线比供应商的报价所显示的更高。”

label.en: “Transaction costs are important, and pricing is important too.”
label.zh: “交易成本很重要，定价也很重要。”

feedback.en: Two claims side by side, no link.
feedback.zh: 两个断言并排，没有联系。

label.en: “Week 8 is about transaction costs and week 10 about price.”
label.zh: “第 8 周讲交易成本，第 10 周讲价格。”

feedback.en: A table of contents, not a link.

label.en: “Firms should lower their prices.”
label.zh: “企业应该降价。”

feedback.en: A recommendation, with no reason from either week.
feedback.zh: 一条建议，没有来自任何一周的理由。

explain.en: A link has a **because** that carries one idea’s output into the other idea’s input. Build the constellation below to find these links yourself.
explain.zh: 联系里有一个**因为**，把一个概念的输出送进另一个概念的输入。搭下面的星图，自己找出这些联系。

text.en: Eight ideas from different weeks, each with a partner from another week that it feeds. The reasons that appear are the sentences to carry into your answers.
text.zh: 来自不同周的八个概念，各有一个来自另一周、被它影响的伙伴。出现的理由，就是要带进答案里的句子。

alt.zh: 八个来自某一周的概念，连到它们所影响的另一周的概念。

pairs.en: Buying in lowers production cost but adds transaction costs: the total sets how low the price can go.
pairs.zh: 外购降低生产成本，但增加交易成本：总成本决定价格能压多低。

pairs.en: Customer intimacy depends on staff who are involved enough to know and serve each customer.
pairs.zh: 客户亲密依赖投入到足以了解并服务每位顾客的员工。

pairs.en: Working with partners to lift suppliers or institutions is the cluster route to shared value.
pairs.zh: 与伙伴一起提升供应商或机构，就是走集群这条路创造共享价值。

pairs.en: A concrete metric can quietly replace an abstract strategy.
pairs.zh: 具体的指标可能悄悄取代抽象的战略。

pairs.en: Each block of the canvas is a place to create or capture the four kinds of value.
pairs.zh: 画布的每个模块都是创造或获取四类价值的地方。

pairs.en: Finding latent needs is how a firm creates unexpected gains.
pairs.zh: 找到潜在需求，企业才能创造意外的收益。

pairs.en: Co-creation is the practical form of the customer as co-creator.
pairs.zh: 共创是“顾客是共同创造者”的实践形式。

pairs.en: The make-or-buy logic of week 8, applied to selling, decides whether to build the sales force.
pairs.zh: 第 8 周的自制或外购逻辑用在销售上，决定是否自建销售队伍。

done.en: These eight links cover most of what a mixed question joins. Each link has the shape **idea A → because → effect on idea B**. In the exam, say it in one sentence, then give the company’s fact.
done.zh: 这八个联系覆盖了混合题大部分要连的东西。每个联系的形状是**概念 A → 因为 → 对概念 B 的影响**。考试时用一句话说出来，再给公司的事实。

no.en: Those two do not feed each other that way.
no.zh: 这两者之间不是这样的影响关系。

text.en: “Explain transaction costs. Show how a firm manages them when it outsources, and how pricing should reflect that.”

why.zh: 交易成本是第 8 周；定价是第 10 周：讲师自己的样题。

done.en: Read the stem for **two nouns from two weeks**. Then plan the answer so that **Explain** defines both ideas and the link, **Apply** uses both on one company, and **Recommend** moves on one idea and says what it does to the other.
done.zh: 读题干，找出**来自两周的两个名词**。然后规划答案：**解释**定义两个概念和它们的联系，**应用**在同一家公司上用两个概念，**建议**动一个概念，并说明它对另一个概念的影响。

title.en: The pattern for a joined answer

items.en: **Find the two ideas** and the link between them, before writing.
items.zh: 写之前先**找出两个概念**及其联系。

items.en: **Explain**: define idea A, define idea B, then one sentence on **why A matters to B**.
items.zh: **解释**：定义概念 A，定义概念 B，再用一句话说**为什么 A 对 B 重要**。

items.en: **Apply**: one company, one or two true facts for each idea, then the because that links them.
items.zh: **应用**：一家公司，每个概念一两条真实事实，再用“因为”把它们连起来。

items.en: **Recommend**: two moves; each says which idea it changes and what that does to the other.
items.zh: **建议**：两个动作；每个都说明它改变哪个概念，以及对另一个概念有什么影响。

title.en: Real links from this course, in one sentence each
title.zh: 本课程里的真实联系，每个一句话

body.en: Coles sold its fuel stations to Viva and kept a supply arrangement that ends in November 2026: the **make-or-buy** choice (week 8) leaves it with **safeguarding costs** at renewal, which matter to **price** (week 10). Hilton does not employ the staff of franchised hotels (week 6), so **the engagement** of those staff depends on the owners, which limits Hilton’s **customer intimacy** (week 2).
body.zh: Coles 把加油站卖给了 Viva，并保留一份 2026 年 11 月到期的供应安排：这个**自制或外购**选择（第 8 周）使它在续约时面临**保障成本**，而这对**价格**（第 10 周）有影响。Hilton 不雇用特许酒店的员工（第 6 周），所以这些员工的**敬业度**取决于业主，这限制了 Hilton 的**客户亲密**（第 2 周）。

title.zh: 写出联系：第 1 周与第 2 周

prompt.en: Write **one sentence** that joins **value types (week 1)** with **positioning (week 2)** for Who Gives a Crap, with one true fact. Use “because”.
prompt.zh: 写**一句话**，把**价值类型（第 1 周）**和**定位（第 2 周）**连起来，对象是 Who Gives a Crap，配一条真实事实。用“因为”。

key_points.en: Names a type of value (symbolic, functional, experiential or cost)
key_points.zh: 点出一种价值类型

key_points.en: Links it to the brand’s position on a map (high on purpose, not low price)
key_points.zh: 把它联系到品牌在图上的位置（公益含量高、价格不低）

key_points.en: Uses a true fact (50% of profits donated, B Corp, or priced at or above budget brands)
key_points.zh: 用一条真实事实

key_points.en: Contains a because
key_points.zh: 含有“因为”

model_answer.en: Because Who Gives a Crap gives 50% of its profits to water and sanitation, it offers symbolic value to buyers, which is why it can sit high on purpose and not low on price on a perceptual map, far from supermarket own brands.
model_answer.zh: 因为 Who Gives a Crap 把 50% 的利润捐给供水和卫生项目，它给买家提供象征价值，这就是它在感知图上能处于“公益含量高、价格不低”、远离超市自有品牌的位置的原因。

explain.en: One sentence, one because, one fact.
explain.zh: 一句话，一个“因为”，一条事实。

title.zh: 写出联系：第 6 周与第 2 周

prompt.en: Write **two sentences** that join **employees’ role (week 6)** with a **value discipline (week 2)** for Hilton. Use a true fact and say what Hilton does or does not control.
prompt.zh: 写**两句话**，把**员工的作用（第 6 周）**和**价值准则（第 2 周）**连起来，对象是 Hilton。用一条真实事实，并说明 Hilton 控制什么、不控制什么。

key_points.en: Names a discipline (customer intimacy or operational excellence) and why staff matter to it
key_points.zh: 点出一种价值准则（客户亲密或卓越运营）以及员工为何对它重要

key_points.en: Uses a true fact: most hotels franchised (about 8,239 against 873 managed and 46 owned) or top workplace 2025
key_points.zh: 用一条真实事实：多数酒店特许经营或 2025 年顶级雇主

key_points.en: Says Hilton does not employ franchised hotels’ staff, so its control is indirect (standards, training)
key_points.zh: 说明 Hilton 不雇用特许酒店的员工，所以控制是间接的（标准、培训）

key_points.en: A because linking the two
key_points.zh: 有“因为”把两者联系起来

model_answer.en: Hilton leans on a customer-intimacy kind of promise, a consistent and personal stay, and that depends on staff, but because about 8,239 of its properties were franchised against 873 managed and 46 owned at the end of 2025, most of those staff are not its employees. So its control is indirect, through brand standards and training, which is why its top workplace ranking in 2025 cannot by itself guarantee the guest’s experience.
model_answer.zh: Hilton 的承诺偏向客户亲密这一类：一致而个性化的住宿体验，而这依赖员工；但因为 2025 年底它约 8,239 家物业是特许经营，873 家受托管理，46 家自有，大多数员工并不是它的雇员。所以它的控制是间接的，通过品牌标准和培训，这也是它 2025 年的顶级雇主排名本身无法保证客人体验的原因。

explain.en: Say what is controlled and what is not.
explain.zh: 说清控制什么、不控制什么。

title.zh: 写出联系：第 8 周与第 10 周

prompt.en: Write **two sentences** that join **make or buy (week 8)** with **pricing (week 10)** for Coles, using the Uber Eats delivery partnership (expanded in FY26) or the Viva supply arrangement (to expire November 2026). One fact, one because.
prompt.zh: 写**两句话**，把**自制或外购（第 8 周）**和**定价（第 10 周）**连起来，对象是 Coles，用 Uber Eats 配送合作（2026 财年扩大）或 Viva 供应安排（2026 年 11 月到期）。一条事实、一个“因为”。

key_points.en: Names a transaction cost (safeguarding, adaptation or measurement) in the buy case
key_points.zh: 点出外购情形里的一项交易成本

key_points.en: Links it to price: a higher total cost of buying raises the cost floor or squeezes margin
key_points.zh: 把它联系到价格：外购总成本更高会抬高成本底线或挤压毛利

key_points.en: Uses a true fact (Uber Eats expanded in FY26; Viva arrangement worth 561 million in FY26 and ending November 2026)
key_points.zh: 用一条真实事实

key_points.en: Flags inference
key_points.zh: 标明推断

model_answer.en: Coles expanded its Uber Eats partnership in FY26, and buying delivery adds measurement costs, since it must check service quality it does not itself provide. Because those costs belong to the total cost of each delivered order, they raise the cost floor under any delivery fee or price, which in my reading is why Coles keeps delivery from its own fulfilment centres for orders where service quality matters.
model_answer.zh: Coles 在 2026 财年扩大了与 Uber Eats 的合作，而外购配送会增加计量成本，因为它必须核查自己并不提供的服务质量。因为这些成本属于每一单配送的总成本，它们抬高了任何配送费或价格之下的成本底线，在我的解读里，这就是 Coles 对服务质量要紧的订单仍用自有履约中心配送的原因。

explain.en: Cost of buying, then what it does to price.
explain.zh: 先说外购的成本，再说它对价格的影响。

prompt.en: Which Recommend part follows from the analysis and links two weeks?
prompt.zh: 哪一条建议是从分析里推出、并连起两周内容的？

label.en: “Renegotiate the supply arrangement early, because safeguarding costs rise near the end date and raise the cost floor under prices.”
label.zh: “提前重新谈判供应安排，因为临近到期保障成本上升，会抬高价格之下的成本底线。”

label.en: “Coles should do more marketing.”
label.zh: “Coles 应该多做营销。”

feedback.en: Generic, with no link to any analysis.
feedback.zh: 泛泛而谈，与任何分析都没有联系。

label.en: “Coles should consider many options, including more stores, more ads and lower prices.”
label.zh: “Coles 应该考虑很多选项，包括更多门店、更多广告和更低价格。”

feedback.en: More than two, none with a reason.

explain.en: Each recommendation names a change and what follows from it.
explain.zh: 每条建议要说明一个改变，以及由此产生的结果。

prompt.en: From lesson 15: surrogation is most likely when the strategy is abstract, the metric is concrete and…
prompt.zh: 来自第 15 课：战略抽象、指标具体时，如果……，替代偏差最可能发生

label.en: staff accept the substitution, even subconsciously
label.zh: 员工接受这种替换，哪怕是下意识的

label.en: the metric is hidden
label.zh: 指标被隐藏

prompt.en: From lesson 17: personalised pricing needs blocked arbitrage because…
prompt.zh: 来自第 17 课：个性化定价需要堵住套利，因为……

label.en: low-price buyers could otherwise resell to high-price buyers
label.zh: 否则低价买家会转卖给高价买家

label.en: it is illegal
label.zh: 它违法

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain how employee engagement supports a customer intimacy strategy. (b) Apply both ideas to Hilton Hotels in Australia. (c) Make two recommendations.

Explain (5 marks). Exceeds: precise, thorough, clear, with the right terms. Meets: accurate, key points present, a little shallow.

Write the **Explain** part.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释员工敬业度怎样支持客户亲密战略。(b) 把这两个概念应用到澳大利亚的 Hilton 酒店。(c) 给出两条建议。

解释（5 分）。优秀：精确、完整、清楚，用对术语。达标：准确、要点齐全，但深度略浅。

写**解释**部分。

key_points.en: Defines engagement (positive emotional attachment, more volatile than commitment) and customer intimacy (value discipline: lifetime value of each customer)
key_points.zh: 定义敬业度（积极的情感依附，比承诺更易波动）和客户亲密（价值准则：每个顾客的终身价值）

key_points.en: Links them: staff who are engaged serve each customer better, which builds lifetime value
key_points.zh: 把两者联系起来：敬业的员工更好地服务每个顾客，从而建立终身价值

key_points.en: Mentions the alignment chain or HR practices that produce engagement
key_points.zh: 提到产生敬业度的对齐链或人力资源做法

key_points.en: Precise terms
key_points.zh: 用词精确

model_answer.en: Engagement is the degree of positive emotional attachment to job, colleagues and organisation; it is more temporary and volatile than commitment and different from satisfaction. Customer intimacy is a value discipline that focuses on the lifetime value of each customer rather than single transactions. They connect because intimacy is delivered through people: engaged staff are willing to learn each customer’s needs and go beyond the task, which builds the relationship and lifetime value. The Strategic Alignment Model shows how acquisition, development, motivation and performance management practices supply the engaged people the strategy needs.
model_answer.zh: 敬业度是对工作、同事和组织的积极情感依附程度；它比承诺更短暂、更易波动，也不同于满意度。客户亲密是一种价值准则，关注每个顾客的终身价值，而不是单次交易。两者的联系在于亲密靠人来交付：敬业的员工愿意了解每位顾客的需求并超越任务本身，这建立了关系和终身价值。战略对齐模型显示，招聘、培养、激励和绩效管理这些做法如何供给战略所需的敬业员工。

explain.en: Compare with the key points and the model answer. A scoring answer says the thing, shows it on this company, and stops.
explain.zh: 对照要点和参考答案。拿分的答案：把概念说准，落到这家公司上，然后收住。

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain how employee engagement supports a customer intimacy strategy. (b) Apply both ideas to Hilton Hotels in Australia. (c) Make two recommendations.

Apply (10 marks). Exceeds: this company, rigorous cause and effect, evidence from the case. Meets: correct and logical, connections could go deeper.

Write the **Apply** part.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释员工敬业度怎样支持客户亲密战略。(b) 把这两个概念应用到澳大利亚的 Hilton 酒店。(c) 给出两条建议。

应用（10 分）。优秀：针对这家公司，因果分析严密，有案例证据。达标：应用正确、逻辑通顺，但联系还可以更深。

写**应用**部分。

key_points.en: Uses true facts: Honors 243 million members; about 8,239 franchised against 873 managed and 46 owned; top workplace 2025
key_points.zh: 用真实事实：Honors 2.43 亿会员；约 8,239 家特许对 873 家管理和 46 家自有；2025 年顶级雇主

key_points.en: Applies both ideas: intimacy through Honors and standards; engagement where Hilton is the employer versus franchised hotels
key_points.zh: 运用两个概念：通过 Honors 和标准实现亲密；Hilton 作为雇主的地方与特许酒店里的敬业度

key_points.en: Cause and effect on the control gap
key_points.zh: 对控制缺口的因果分析

key_points.en: Notes the facts are global
key_points.zh: 说明事实是全球的

model_answer.en: These figures are Hilton’s global ones. Hilton’s relationship with guests runs through Honors, with 243 million members, which gives it data and contact to treat guests as individuals, an intimacy-type promise. That promise depends on staff, yet about 8,239 properties were franchised against 873 managed and 46 owned at the end of 2025, so most staff work for owners. Hilton was named a top workplace in 2025, which shows what engagement it can build where it is the employer, but in franchised hotels owners hire, motivate and manage staff, so engagement and the intimacy it supports are only as strong as owners’ practices. That control gap is where the promise is most at risk.
model_answer.zh: 这些数字是 Hilton 的全球数据。Hilton 与客人的关系通过拥有 2.43 亿会员的 Honors 运行，这给了它把客人当作个体对待的数据和联系，是一种客户亲密型的承诺。这个承诺依赖员工，但 2025 年底约 8,239 家物业是特许经营，873 家受托管理，46 家自有，所以多数员工为业主工作。Hilton 在 2025 年被评为顶级雇主，说明它在自己做雇主的地方能建立怎样的敬业度，但在特许酒店里是业主雇用、激励和管理员工，所以敬业度及其所支持的亲密，只和业主的做法一样强。这个控制缺口，正是承诺最有风险的地方。

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain how employee engagement supports a customer intimacy strategy. (b) Apply both ideas to Hilton Hotels in Australia. (c) Make two recommendations.

Recommend (5 marks). Exceeds: exactly two, realistic, strategic, actionable, each following from your analysis, with a risk named. Meets: sound but thin on how.

Write the **Recommend** part: exactly two.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释员工敬业度怎样支持客户亲密战略。(b) 把这两个概念应用到澳大利亚的 Hilton 酒店。(c) 给出两条建议。

建议（5 分）。优秀：恰好两条，现实、有战略性、可执行，都从你的分析里推出来，并点出风险。达标：合理，但“怎么做”偏薄。

写**建议**部分：恰好两条。

key_points.en: Exactly two from the analysis, each naming the idea it changes and its effect on the other
key_points.zh: 恰好两条，从分析里推出，各自说明改变哪个概念及其对另一个的影响

key_points.en: Each actionable
key_points.zh: 每条可执行

key_points.en: A risk named
key_points.zh: 点出风险

model_answer.en: First, offer franchisee staff the same service training and recognition programme as managed hotels, because engagement depends on practices and Hilton controls only brand standards there. This raises engagement, which should lift guest scores. The risk is cost to owners, so share the cost. Second, add guest-service measures to the Honors survey for each franchised hotel and report them to owners, because intimacy cannot be managed if it is not measured. The risk is blame, so pair reports with support.
model_answer.zh: 第一，给特许酒店的员工提供与受托管理酒店相同的服务培训和认可计划，因为敬业度取决于做法，而 Hilton 在那里只控制品牌标准。这能提高敬业度，进而应该提高客人评分。风险是业主的成本，所以分摊成本。第二，在 Honors 调查中为每家特许酒店加入客人服务指标并向业主报告，因为亲密无法在不被衡量的情况下被管理。风险是互相指责，所以报告要配上支持。
